fill.obs_text: The surfaces of this group (considered, gives thought, meditate, meditates, meditation, musing, pondering, ponders, weigh, weighing) share one kind of meaning in the dictionary: attending to a matter and turning it over in the mind. The codes give it as considering and pondering (G1760, G2657, G1380, G3049, H2803H, H2803J, H7920, H7919A, H7760K, H7896K, H0239), as meditating and muttering (H1897, H7878, H7742, H7881, H7879, H1900, H1902H), as weighing and judging (H6424, G1252, H8254) and as attending to a person or thing (H7200H, H6437G, H3820A, G4820). Several codes and surfaces are at the edge of the group: H4948 (weight) and H5187 (laden) and H8254 in Ezr 8:29 are the literal weighing of goods and silver and name no act of the mind; H1934, H0595, H5921A, G3756 and G2233 stand in units of verses where the sense is carried by another code or is a small word.
